items.claim: John Port has good takedown defense using a sprawl and hip positioning.
items.quote: He's got good take down defense. Gets sprawl. Um uses, you know, uses like a strong like hip to block the uh the takedown.

items.claim: John Port actively fights out of bad positions and submission attempts rather than staying stuck on the bottom.
items.quote: doesn't accept the bottom and he'll fight out of bad positions. You'll see him in a lot of like kind of submission attempts... and then end up on top position

items.claim: Magomed Bibulatov is the better striker compared to Damian Rebesky.
items.quote: I do think he's the better striker by just a smidge

items.claim: Magomed Bibulatov is the better grappler compared to Damian Rebesky.
items.quote: I definitely think he's the better grappler

items.claim: Wellington Turman has a record of two wins and three losses in his last five fights.
items.quote: Two and three in the last five for Turman.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov has an undefeated record of five and zero.
Islam Dulatov sometimes rushes in with wild barrages.
items.quote: he does rush in sometimes with a barrage.

items.claim: Tyrell Fortune has a record of four wins and one loss in his last five fights.
items.quote: Fortune is four and one in his last five.

items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev has a record of three wins, one loss, and one no contest.
items.quote: We got three, one, and a no contest for Kuniev.

items.claim: Tyrell Fortune is the cleaner and better striker in the matchup with Rizvan Kuniev.
items.quote: good striker, probably the better striker here, the cleaner striker.

items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev sometimes swings big and wild when closing the distance.
items.quote: when he goes to close the distance, he just kind of swings big and wild to close.

items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev has good takedown defense.
items.quote: solid grappler though, good takedown defense
